items.title: From detecting contamination to predicting risk
items.summary: Environmental monitoring helps sterile manufacturers spot weaknesses early, protect product quality and prevent costly disruptions.

items.title: London Life Sciences Week: Dealmaking, AI, and China the talk of the town
items.summary: Included in this episode are key takeaways from several events across London Life Sciences Week, including Jeffries, London Biotech Show and the DIA-MHRA.

items.title: Sanofi buys US drugmaker Insmed for $41bn to expand respiratory portfolio
items.summary: The deal marks the largest pharma acquisition since 2023, and the most Sanofi has outlaid in a deal since 2004.

items.title: Platforms vs assets: More innovation bolsters pharma pipelines
items.summary: At the London Biotechnology Show, experts highlighted how pharma has changed its deal-making strategy as it undergoes a patent cliff.

items.title: FDA approves AbbVie’s Rinvoq for nonsegmental vitiligo
items.summary: The US FDA has approved AbbVie's Rinvoq (upadacitinib) for adults and paediatric patients aged 12 years and older with nonsegmental vitiligo.
